title: 09. Backend Python: GIT FOR DEVELOPERS
summary: GIT FOR DEVELOPERS: explanations and runnable examples.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```bash name=git/git_commands.sh
# ============================================================
# GIT — Version Control (Every Developer Must Know)
# ============================================================

# --- Setup ---
git config --global user.name "Veerababu"
git config --global user.email "veera@test.com"

# --- Basic Workflow ---
git init                           # Initialize repo
git clone <url>                    # Clone remote repo
git status                         # Check status
git add .                          # Stage all changes
git add file.py                    # Stage specific file
git commit -m "feat: add user API" # Commit with message
git push origin main               # Push to remote

# --- Branching ---
git branch feature/user-api        # Create branch
git checkout feature/user-api      # Switch to branch
git checkout -b feature/new        # Create + switch
git branch -d feature/done         # Delete branch
git branch -a                      # List all branches

# --- Merging ---
git checkout main
git merge feature/user-api         # Merge branch into main
git merge --squash feature/messy   # Squash all commits into one

# --- Rebasing (cleaner history) ---
git checkout feature/my-branch
git rebase main                    # Rebase onto main
git rebase -i HEAD~3               # Interactive rebase (squash, edit, reorder)

# --- Stashing ---
git stash                          # Save uncommitted changes
git stash list                     # List stashes
git stash pop                      # Apply and remove latest stash
git stash apply stash@{1}         # Apply specific stash

# --- Undoing ---
git reset --soft HEAD~1            # Undo last commit, keep changes staged
git reset --mixed HEAD~1           # Undo last commit, keep changes unstaged
git reset --hard HEAD~1            # Undo last commit, DISCARD changes
git revert <commit-hash>           # Create new commit that undoes a commit
git checkout -- file.py            # Discard changes in file

# --- Log ---
git log --oneline --graph --all    # Visual branch history
git log --author="Veera"           # Filter by author
git log --since="2024-01-01"       # Filter by date
git diff main..feature             # Compare branches
git blame file.py                  # Who changed each line

# --- Tags ---
git tag v1.0.0                     # Lightweight tag
git tag -a v1.0.0 -m "Release 1"  # Annotated tag
git push origin v1.0.0             # Push tag

# --- Cherry-pick ---
git cherry-pick <commit-hash>      # Apply specific commit to current branch

# --- Conventional Commits ---
# feat: new feature
# fix: bug fix
# docs: documentation
# style: formatting
# refactor: restructuring
# test: adding tests
# chore: maintenance
```
